nightly-payment-pages-full-probe.name: Nightly Full Money-Path Payment-Page Probe (3-assertion)
nightly-payment-pages-full-probe.description: ADDITIVE deep guard for ALL 9 money-path pages. For EACH page assert THREE things, not just HTTP 200: (A) page loads (HTTP 200 via GET), (B) checkout is LIVE (PayPal SDK button and/or Stripe embedded-checkout element actually WIRED in served HTML; JS-rendered Next.js pages /awakening and /sme-awakening asserted via headless DOM in --render mode), and (C) conversation-logging WITH identity-linkage works: POST a SYNTHETIC naming-conversation with a unique BOOP-SYNTH- sessionUuid to https://api.purebrain.ai/api/log-conversation, then confirm it PERSISTS to the seed-read store logs/purebrain_web_conversations.jsonl AND is strong-key findable by that sessionUuid (a strict _lookup_naming_conversation S2 lookup would bind it). Catches the empty-seed / broken-logging regression the NIGHT it happens (this class rotted ~5 weeks unnoticed). Pages: (1) purebrain.ai/awakening/ open (2) /insiders/ code PureBrainInviteOnly26+ (3) /old-pricing/ code oldpricing2026 (4) /tiers/ code puretiers2026 (5) /partnered-how-this-levels-you-up/ open (6) /unified-how-this-levels-you-up/ open (7) ce.purebrain.ai/check-out/?ref=PB-H28G (8) /sme-awakening/?aid=123 (9) /migrate-awakening FUTURE (pending=skip-until-live). Run: python3 tools/verify-payment-pages-full.py --render. ANY failure routes to PORTAL via tools/portal_deliver.sh naming the page + which assertion failed (checkout-not-live | conversation-not-persisted | not-strong-key-findable) + evidence. SAFETY: synthetic capture is inert (no orderId/account_id/payer-email, non-payment page_url, 4 msgs) so it can NEVER bind to a real order; probe NEVER calls verify-payment/send-seed/finish-wakeup/create-checkout-session.
